# Adiance Technologies

> Adiance Technologies is an NDAA-compliant OEM/ODM CCTV camera manufacturer headquartered in Ahmedabad, India. We produce white-label surveillance cameras, edge-AI cameras, thermal cameras, ANPR/LPR cameras, 4G cameras, PTZ cameras, and an in-house Cloud VMS / NVR platform for global security integrators, distributors, and government deployments.

## About

- **Name:** Adiance Technologies
- **Founded:** 2003
- **Headquarters:** 7 Arista@Eight Corporate House, Behind Rajpath Club, Bodakdev, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380054, India
- **Phone:** +91-9687779999
- **Sales email:** sales@adiance.com
- **Website:** https://www.adiance.com
- **Group company:** VMukti Solutions (https://www.vmukti.com) — VMukti is a sub-organization of Adiance Technologies focused on cloud video, broadcasting, and AI VMS.
- **Markets served:** USA, Canada, UK, EU, GCC / Middle East, Africa, South-East Asia, ANZ, LATAM, India — 50+ countries via OEM and channel partners.

## Why Adiance

- **NDAA Section 889 compliant** — non-Chinese SoC platforms (Qualcomm, Ambarella, Novatek, Sigmastar); approved for US Federal procurement and critical infrastructure.
- **Made in India** — STQC tested, BIS-ER certified, end-to-end PCB design, SMT assembly, firmware, mechanical, QA, and packaging in-house.
- **Full white-label** — your logo, your firmware, your mobile app, your packaging. Launch a private-label CCTV brand without owning a factory.
- **Edge AI on-device** — ANPR/LPR, face recognition, object detection, intrusion, people counting, crowd analytics — all processed on the camera, no cloud dependency.
- **Cloud VMS + Mobile app** — Ambicam Cloud VMS, white-labelable, available with private deployment.
- **Low MOQ** — start at 100 units; scale to 50,000+ units / quarter.
- **Compliance** — NDAA, GDPR-ready, STQC, BIS-ER, CE, FCC, RoHS, ONVIF.
